lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Helga Song is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Helga Song is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Helga kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Helga's gone." Somad looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Helga." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ellie blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Pipes & Waterworks (Level 1). Water follows gravity and the path of least resistance. Find the line, find the water.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Helga Song, 41 days. The mantle passes to Ellie Hamilton.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ellie Hamilton, 33 — a plumber. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Helga — and Helga is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: You knew Helga — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
d41: At the grave, Paolo, Somad, Dhruv and 2 more speak for Ellie — "Helga trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Ellie before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
